title: The Twin Shield Discipline
summary: The school course in raising two soul shields in step and closing a contest with the school's pairing of guard and return.

title: Manual of the Paired Mind Court
summary: The school manual of two minds held as a court that judges each blow and turns it back as the court decrees.

title: The Azure Hawk Mind-Guard
summary: The school guard of the high clear mind that sees every strike from above and drops to answer it.

title: Dual-Track Crown of the Soul
summary: The school's high course of two tracks of soul that meet at the crown and shield a whole company at once.

title: The Gale Oath of the Held Mind
summary: The school discipline of the oath sworn to the wind that keeps the mind unmoved in any gale of will.

title: Plateau Calm Reckoning
summary: The school reckoning of a calm as broad and level as a plateau that no gust can rouse.

title: Reckoning of the Steady Bearing
summary: The school reckoning of a bearing taken once and held so steadily that the pull of any greater will fails.

title: Oath Held Under Tempest
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn beneath the storm and held whole through the fall of every other guard.
